objects.name: Analytic 2119
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies writes to serial device configuration files or `stty` commands changing serial port parameters on Industrial Control System (ICS) Linux gateway hosts from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with authorized serial port management. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL+PATH
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL+PATH records: PATH record shows modification of a serial-device configuration file by a UID not in the authorized serial-administration set

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time window within which a serial gateway configuration change and subsequent device communication loss are considered causally connected.
